newsitem.title: GERMANY: China transport fair planned for March 1998.
newsitem.headline: China transport fair planned for March 1998.

text.p: A single transport fair covering all aspects of the Chinese market will be held in Beijing from March 23-27, l998, joint organiser Messe Muenchen said.

"TC China 98" combining the previous TC China and Modern Railways fairs, would focus on the large-scale transport and infrastructure projects included in the current Chinese five-year plan, a statement said.

Professor Wang Derong, vice-president and secretary-general of the China Communications & Transportation Association (CCTA), said the first two TC China fairs drew 60,000 visitors including government officials and industry decision-makers.

The event would also include a Chinese-German congress on development and management of transport systems, he added. The other organisers of TC China 98 are the CCTA and the Berlin-based German-Chinese co-operation office for transport (DCKVT). - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
